text:
sophie: Quick heads-up — Go SDK v0.8.0 is sending the model-list timeout param as `timeoutMs` while REST expects `timeout_ms`. Our go-sampleapp onboarding hit silent timeouts.
matt: Oof. Same underscored vs camelCase drift we've seen. Which endpoint?
sophie: GET /v1/models/list?timeout_ms=2000 vs SDK: client.ListModels(ctx, &ListOpts{TimeoutMs:2000}) -> request goes out as `timeoutMs=2000`. Server ignores it.
go-sdk-bot: New issue created: redwood/go-sdk#341 - "param casing mismatch: timeoutMs vs timeout_ms"
matt: Also noticed the Go client is missing a wrapper for `/v1/models/:id/aliases` so engineers are doing raw HTTP in sample apps. Please add that to SDK surface.
sophie: Workaround added in sample-apps: normalizer that maps camelCase -> snake_case, but this is messy and leaks SDK quirks into user code.
eng-runtime: We'll add temporary server-side leniency to accept both casings for a short deprecation window, but the SDK must ship a fix.
matt: Another issue: 429 responses with `Retry-After` are not honored by the Go SDK retry logic (it retries immediately). Plan: hotfix 0.8.1 within 24h to honor Retry-After, full 0.9.0 with mapping tests in two weeks.
sophie: Filed INF-2299 to track parity audit. I'll update quickstart docs to mention the temporary adapter and add a CI integration comparing curl vs go-sdk responses.
matt: Please add changelog entries and a migration note for Go SDK users.
